editorial.blurb: A Chicago seafood institution since 1968, Half Shell serves impeccably fresh crab, oysters, and chowder in a gloriously no-frills basement setting that hasn't changed in decades.
editorial.insiderTip: Bring cash (there's an ATM on-site) and arrive early for outdoor seating on nice days—or call ahead to claim a table, as the patio becomes highly contested. Ask for Mike for excellent service.
